name: Areola
description: Two rings of different weight, close enough together to read as one thick edge.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 20%, #000 20% 30%, transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 36%, #000 36% 48%, transparent 48%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 20%, #000 20% 30%, transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 36%, #000 36% 48%, transparent 48%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
